* Debian installation
Instructions for install my debian system with my
custom configuration and packages.

** TODO (spelling) Prerequisits
The guide assumes the starting point to be a freshly
installed system with no desktop manager selected during
install.

** ssh-keys
*** Generate ssh-key
#+begin_src bash
ssh-keygen
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
#+end_src

Then just add the keys to gitlab and github.
*** Alternative option
Another option is to just copy the current key to the new system.
#+begin_src bash
scp ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub user@newhost:~/.ssh/
#+end_src
** Update system
run as superuser:
#+BEGIN_SRC bash
apt update && apt upgrade
#+END_SRC
** Install initial packages
#+BEGIN_SRC bash
apt install git sudo
#+END_SRC
** add user to sudo group
#+begin_src
usermod -aG sudo erik
newgrp sudo
#+end_src
** clone repositories
Dotfiles:
#+begin_src bash
git clone git@github.com:erik-sundin-git/dotfiles.git ~/dotfiles
#+end_src

Notes:
#+begin_src bash
git clone git@gitlab.com:vr35/notes.git ~/notes
#+end_src
** install packages
First add non-free and contrib to apt/sources.list
#+begin_src bash
sudo sed -i 's/main non-free-firmware$/main contrib non-free non-free-firmware/' /etc/apt/sources.list
sudo apt update
#+end_src

now install required packages:
#+begin_src bash
 sudo apt install $(cat dotfiles/debian/installed_packages.txt)
#+end_src
** nix
install the nix package manager
#+begin_src bash
sh <(curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -L https://nixos.org/nix/install) --daemon
#+end_src

start nix
#+begin_src bash
. /nix/var/nix/profiles/default/etc/profile.d/nix-daemon.sh
#+end_src
